question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is "reversed."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The term** "reversed"** in this context suggests that the changes that have occurred in the education sector are difficult or impossible to undo. • **"Reversed"** means to change the direction, order, position, result, etc. of something to its opposite. (किसी चीज़ की दिशा, क्रम, स्थिति, परिणाम आदि को उसके विपरीत में बदलना) • It implies that the transformations or developments are significant and have altered the state of the education sector in a way that cannot easily be turned back. • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4. ​ Correct paragraph: The challenge in Madras high court to the Emergency-era shifting of education from state list to concurrent list is__ a futile exercise in turning back the clock. Forty-six years have passed __since__ the 42 Constitution Amendment Act. In this period, the education sector has seen far too many changes, and most can’t be __**reversed**__. For instance, a common national medical test now allows students the ease of appearing for just one examination instead of multiple ones conducted by each state. States still enjoy ______ (4) ______ to operate their own universities, schools and education syllabus.......... [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Turned: **move in a circular direction wholly or partly round an axis or point. (किसी अक्ष या बिंदु के चारों ओर पूर्णतः या आंशिक रूप से गोलाकार दिशा में घूमना) • **Backed: **give financial, material, or moral support to. (वित्तीय, भौतिक या नैतिक समर्थन देना) • **Returned: **come or go back to a place or person. (किसी स्थान या व्यक्ति के पास आना या वापस जाना) 4a:T14e0, The correct answer is "flexibility."
